name: youtube-watch-party
description: Watch YouTube together in real time — React + Node.js + Socket.IO (WebSockets) + MongoDB

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix client
